title: Tools
description: Software Claude can drive with code. The judge looks here to see whether an idea can be built or simulated.

domain.description: e.g. 3D, CAD, robotics, electronics, data/CV, web, other.

control.description: How Claude drives it: CLI, Python API, headless, MCP. GUI-only tools do not belong here.

detect.description: How to check it is installed: any listed command on PATH or any listed path that exists.

install_cmd.description: Command to install it, per operating system.

can_simulate.description: What this tool lets a PoC model or build.
